entities.name: Query acireductone dioxygenase
observations: 183 aa soluble acidic protein; predicted molecular mass 21.1 kDa and pI 4.95.
Matches curated acireductone dioxygenases at 65.3–68.0% identity with 96.2–98.9% query coverage and E-values 7.89e-79 to 1.64e-89.
Pfam detects ARD domain PF03079 at residues 16–169 and cupin-related domains PF07883/PF00190 near residues 98–171.
Likely monomeric non-heme metal enzyme; exact Fe-versus-Ni reaction cannot be assigned from sequence alone.

entities.name: Acireductone dioxygenase
observations: Curated homologs bind one Fe2+ or Ni2+ ion per monomer.
Fe-containing enzyme converts acireductone to 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate and formate; Ni-containing enzyme produces methylthiopropionate, carbon monoxide, and formate.
The enzyme is part of the methionine salvage/recycling pathway when operating in the Fe-dependent mode.

entities.name: Methionine salvage pathway
observations: Acireductone dioxygenase catalyzes the penultimate oxidative cleavage step in L-methionine salvage from S-methyl-5-thioribose 1-phosphate, producing the methionine precursor 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate in the Fe-dependent branch.
